question: Who has taken the oath as the Chief Minister of Meghalaya in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Conrad K Sangma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Conrad Kongkal Sangma **is a prominent Indian politician and the current **Chief Minister of Meghalaya.**
 
• **In 2008, at the age of 30,** he became Meghalaya's **Finance Minister**, making him one of the youngest finance ministers in India at the time.
 
• Under Conrad’s leadership, the NPP became the first regional party from the northeast to attain **national party status in 2019.**
 
• The current** Governor of Meghalaya is Phagu Chauhan**. He was appointed as the Governor of Meghalaya on February 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thomas A Sangma** is the **Speaker** of the Meghalaya Legislative Assembly, elected in 2023.
 
• **Sniawbhalang Dhar** is an elected member of the Meghalaya Legislative Assembly, representing the Nartiang constituency in the Jaintia Hills region.
 
• **Prestone Tynsong **currently serves as the **Deputy Chief Minister** of Meghalaya.
 
• As of the 2011 census, Meghalaya had a population of approximately 3 million people.
 
• **English is the official language** of Meghalaya, and it is widely used for government and administrative purposes.
 
• **Khasi, Garo, and Jaintia** are the **main regional languages** spoken in the state, reflecting the cultural diversity of the indigenous tribes.
 
• Meghalaya has a **unicameral legislature** known as the Meghalaya Legislative Assembly with 60 members.
